The raw-receipt validator checks comparability/coverage but does not apply the statistical performance verdict; PM3.2 owns collector/reducer implementation and real artifact verification.
Next: PM3.2 validates installed versions, source/data/output equality, endpoint/duration adapters and complete materialization before measuring the first paired CSV-to-I-VT baseline. Eleven bounded follow-on adapter tickets reuse that collector; S10.6 remains the Studio owner. Performance thresholds are prospective and frozen before observations. Release claim/reservation for handoff; user retains push authority.
